review_notes: The amendment removes the previous defer-only implementation, avoiding early DISTINCT pre-map definitions and their loss of raw window keys.
Effective DISTINCT is false only for processing result-window queries; ordinary scalar result expressions then use the normal final evaluation path.
Window calls and enclosing result expressions materialize before final projecting Map, and only that visible tuple defines DISTINCT equality.
Ordinary aggregation and grouping-key preservation remain before windows; normal nondistinct and nonwindow DISTINCT paths retain their existing logic.
The original DISTINCT HAVING and grouping-sets unsupported guards remain, rather than accidentally expanding unsupported scope.
Final ORDER BY runs after result DISTINCT. Frontend type checking rejects hidden extra ORDER BY fields for DISTINCT queries.
Duplicate output label disambiguation occurs before finalProjection is used as the deduplication key set.
Existing group-reference, alias, and independent aggregate limitations are not changed or counted fixed.
pending_native_acceptance: Original four failing window DISTINCT profiles plus nondistinct and nonwindow controls.
Hidden window inputs, selected ordinary expressions/constants, duplicate values with differing hidden keys, multiple windows, and visible-alias ORDER BY.
Grouped aggregate/window interactions where otherwise supported; independent C12/C13/F01 behavior must be distinguished.
